description: This Java class represents a configuration implementation for exponential back-off, including settings such as minimum and maximum durations, a randomization factor, and a timeout for corrupted receive events. It is part of the supervision configuration package within the Eclipse Ditto services.

classes.name: DefaultExponentialBackOffConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing the ExponentialBackOffConfig interface, encapsulating backoff timing configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate DefaultExponentialBackOffConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum duration for backoff.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum duration for backoff.

methods.name: getRandomFactor
methods.description: Returns the randomization factor applied to backoff durations.

methods.name: getCorruptedReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration after which a corrupted receive timeout is considered.
